limitations: The theorem classifies only translations of a fixed ball and does not change the arbitrary-set isoperimetric problem. The critical p=2-n identity is classical Newton-shell potential theory; the originality claim is limited to the complete weighted-perimeter translation phase diagram and its consequences. Equivalent prior Riesz-potential coverage remains a residual risk; independent audit has not been performed.
